name: ralph-claude-code
description: > **Autonomous AI development loop with intelligent exit detection and rate limiting**

scripts.test: bash -c 'BATS_BIN=./node_modules/.bin/bats; if [ -x "$BATS_BIN" ]; then "$BATS_BIN" tests/unit/ tests/integration/; elif command -v bats >/dev/null 2>&1; then bats tests/unit/ tests/integration/; else echo "Error: bats not found. Install with: cd tools/ralph && pnpm install (network) OR brew install bats-core" >&2; exit 127; fi'
